title: PGR + Poachek + Fe + Urea, Greens
sheet_name: JD - 300L/Ha - PGR to Greens (TE + Ethephon + Poachek + Fe)
last_load: Remediator Flush + Chino, Greens, Wed 4 Nov: rinse the boom first
site_check: Spray signs out on every green. Greens mown and blown, debris and clippings off
weather: Delta T 2–8 · check the sock: forecast gusts 31–37 km/h · under 25 °C · dry from now
extra_checks: Clean water run through the boom first
Yesterday's tank had Remediator and Chino in it
Bucket test: one nozzle for 1 minute at 3.4 bar
300 L/ha at 7.1 km/h needs about 2.7 L/min on 75 cm nozzle spacing (1.8 L/min on 50 cm). If it's out, call Andy before you fill
Wind sock checked before you start
Stop if it's blowing off target
pH is checked before the Promote goes in

products.why: The label says Companion goes in first, before anything else. It holds the tank pH down for the ethephon.
Acidic (pH about 2). Brings the tank pH back down after the urea, ready for the Promote.

products.note: Goes in last, after a pH check (sheet has it 5th).
products.why: Check the tank is under pH 4.5 first. If it's 4.5 or above, stop and call Andy. Goes in last so the ethephon never sits in a higher-pH tank. You're at {before} L.

ppe_note: Poachek is a Schedule 6 poison and fatal if breathed in: mist mask, face shield and elbow gloves when you pour it, and the mist mask stays on while you spray. Promote Plus 900 is corrosive and the iron is a strong acid: goggles, face shield and apron. Eyewash on the rig.
spray_rules: All greens. Greens mown and blown first: debris and clippings off, dry leaf
Check the sock before you start. Gusts are forecast 31–37 km/h from first light: stop if it's blowing off target
Medal is off the 1st and 10th from 7:00am with no clear nine. Get as much done before 7 as you can, then work between groups. Never spray a green with golfers on or near it
Foliar pass: do NOT water in. No irrigation or hand watering on the greens for 24 h
Keep people off each green until it's dry
spray_more: Poachek label: not above 25 °C, dry turf, keep dry for 24 h after, fine spray 500–1000 L/ha, not on kikuyu or red fescue. Promote Plus 900: no rain within 8 h, don't leave the mix standing in metal for more than 2 h. Shadow Ultra: no rain or irrigation within 1 h, no entry without protective clothing until dry.
post_checks: Greens irrigation off for 24 h, including #38 tonight, and nobody hand watering
Poachek: keep the turf dry for 24 h

flags.t: #38 Spatially Claude Greens runs at 7:30pm tonight
flags.d: It was ON (every day, 7:30pm) when last checked. Tonight's run lands inside Poachek's 24 h dry period from a morning spray. It needs to be off tonight, or set to zero.

flags.t: Wind: gusts 31–37 km/h from first light
flags.d: Open-Meteo at 5am: 19 km/h gusting 35 now, 36–41 from 8 to 10am, easing to 22–27 after 4pm. The 6th station read SSW 5 gusting 8 at 4:45am, so check the sock. Fallback is 5–8pm (9 km/h gusting 22), which still stays dry until about 9pm Friday.

flags.t: Urea 50 kg/ha: 23 kg N/ha foliar, no water-in
flags.d: Confirmed by Andy. With 20 L/ha iron (pH about 2) on the leaf and no water-in, there's some burn risk; the cool day (max about 17 °C) keeps it down. 100 kg of urea in about 400 L drops the tank temperature by roughly 10 °C and dissolves slowly, so it goes in 2nd and must be fully dissolved before the PGRs.
Dew point 7.6 °C and heavy dew at dawn; Poachek's label wants dry turf. Mowing and blowing first gets most of it off.
Urea moves from last to 2nd so it dissolves early. Promote Plus moves from 5th to last, after a pH check under 4.5, so the ethephon never sits in a tank the urea has pushed up.
flags.s: Andy 5 Nov · reasoning on each product card

flags.d: Trinexapac 210 of 200 GDD since 21 Oct (due). Ethephon day 22 of its 14–28 day window. Paclobutrazol (Regulate 28 Oct) at 95 of 350 GDD, still working: three PGRs plus endothal on the bentgrass.

15 days after the 21 Oct pass (label 2–3 sprays 10–14 days apart). 0.75 L/ha is half the 1.5 L/ha label rate, and 300 L/ha is under its 500–1000 L/ha fine-spray volume. All greens this time, including the practice green, 1st and 10th.

flags.t: Nozzles: grey at 3.4 bar is about 284 L/ha
flags.d: Grey is ISO size 06: about 2.5 L/min at 3.4 bar. At 7.1 km/h that's about 284 L/ha on 75 cm nozzle spacing. The bucket test on the rig checklist confirms it.
